items.title: CC-4 Dai-Freed Torsion Pairing with π_4(S³) = ℤ/2 (PRIORITY 4)
items.what: Construct the Dai-Freed pairing of `[D_K]` on Jensen-SU(3) with the `π_4(S³) = ℤ/2` torsion bundle class from the SU(2) fibration `S³ → SU(3) → S⁵`. Compute the pairing value in ℝ/ℤ. Evaluate **both** `pairing × M_Pl² × H_0²` AND `π × pairing × M_Pl² × H_0²` and report which matches ρ_obs (resolves
items.inputs: D_K structure on Jensen-SU(3); principal SU(2)-bundle data; Dai-Freed 1994 machinery (arXiv:9405012 or equivalent); Pin(4)⁺ anomaly structure from Witten (2015) for cross-check; canonical M_Pl and H_0
